head: ChatGPT tests a new phone layout with a tab bar and a Dot tab
dek: OpenAI is rolling out a new ChatGPT mobile design with a bottom tab bar, a tab for your dot and tools you can pin, first to Pro users and a small group of Plus users (not in the EEA, UK, Switzerland or South Korea). If New ChatGPT Design appears in Settings, you can switch it on or off there.
